# Support Central York Science Olympiad
### Invest in the next generation of scientists, engineers, and problem-solvers.

Your support helps our students compete, experiment, build, and learn at the highest level.

[Become a Sponsor](#become-a-sponsor){.btn .btn-primary .btn-lg}
:::

## Why Sponsor Us?

Science Olympiad gives students the opportunity to take science beyond the classroom. Through hands-on experimentation, engineering, research, and competition, our team develops skills that last far beyond tournament day.

Your sponsorship helps provide the materials, equipment, travel, and resources our students need throughout the season.

### Your support helps fund

- Laboratory supplies and chemicals
- Engineering and construction materials
- Scientific equipment and instrumentation
- Tournament registration and competition expenses
- Travel to competitions
- Team merchandise and competition materials
- Resources for practices and student preparation

::: {.callout-important}
## Every contribution makes a difference

Whether you are a local business, organization, family, or individual, your support directly contributes to opportunities for Central York students.
:::

## Sponsorship Opportunities

::: {.sponsor-tier}
### 🐾 Panther Sponsor

## $100+

**Recognition**

- Your name listed on our **Our Sponsors** webpage
- Shoutout on our team social media
:::

::: {.sponsor-tier}
### 🥉 Bronze Sponsor

## $250+

**Everything included with Panther, plus:**

- Your organization's logo on our team competition banner
- Banner displayed at competitions throughout the season
:::

::: {.sponsor-tier}
### 🥈 Silver Sponsor

## $500+

**Everything included with Bronze, plus:**

- Your organization's logo on team T-shirts
- Shirts worn by team members at competitions throughout the season
:::

::: {.sponsor-tier}
### 🥇 Gold Sponsor

## $1,000+

**Everything included with Silver, plus:**

- Large logo placement on team shirts
- Prominent logo placement on our competition banner
- Logo placement on selected team competition builds and displays
:::
